object_description: fragmented ensemble enclosing a large interior park
design_condition: The ensemble forms a peripheral urban square and a large interior park, with public programs to the west and most entrances placed along the northern and existing-road edges, closing the site toward its neighbours.

positive.statement: The initial conceptual choices, especially the large complex organized around a park, are of interest.

position.rationale: Fragmented volumes visibly form a large enclosure around the central open park.

positive.statement: The central landscaped location with a lake and green spaces that residents can colonize is very appealing.

position.target: central landscaped location with lake and green spaces
position.rationale: Central void between the surrounding sampled volumes provides the landscape anchor.

positive.statement: The flexible, free-form character contrasts with the rigor of the teaching buildings and creates a real break in the student day.

position.rationale: Multiple irregularly angled volumes visibly contrast with the ensemble's more regular edges.

positive.statement: The project is fundamentally sound, with foundations, structure, energy, and sustainable development well understood.

position.rationale: Structural systems are not separable, so the marker covers a representative building mass.

positive.statement: The compactness of the buildings and recommended construction methods lead to an economical project.

position.rationale: Compactness is represented across a plausible peripheral building volume.

negative.statement: The purpose of the large park is not convincing, because the ground-floor components and entrances do not exploit its relationship with the park.

position.rationale: The central open area is visible, though ground-floor relationships are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: Most entrances are located on the periphery, leaving the park as a place of passage that does not encourage vitality.

position.rationale: Northern and edge-facing perimeter bands constrain the likely entrance locations.

negative.statement: The scale of the two U-shaped elements denies connections with neighbouring urban areas and closes off the site.

position.rationale: Two visibly U-like peripheral masses enclose and separate the central open area.

negative.statement: The expression of the ensemble fails to convince, appearing more like an administrative complex.

position.rationale: The marker covers the ensemble's visible collection of repeated institutional volumes.

negative.statement: The vehicle crossover encroaches into the legal distance from the forest and is incompatible with the applicable allocation plan.

position.rationale: A perimeter site-edge location approximates the externally described crossover.
